text: Verified on main 9431e120: resolved by 4ff8f72c ('Connect native Studio previews, reports, navigation and stored workflows'). The protocol ResultSummary is now scale-free run facts (Views.scala 'Scale-free run facts. Reporting edits read numerical cells only through report(run, spec, scale)'); studio-app ParticipantMeans.of takes the scale from the served ReportView (report.scale), so no scale is inferred by float equality and no 'pending this bead' comment remains. GroupMeans/ScoreMeans/dByScale survive only in the fake fixture MockStudy. Closing.
